items.title: Marty Napoleon interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, New York, January 16, 1999
items.q: we got to be good friends

ctx.x: Tony Spargo. His real name was Barbaro but he changed it to Spargo because everybody couldn’t say Barbaro. And Tony Spargo, he used to play the kazoo when he played a solo, and he would like he had a big Chinese crash cymbal. Boy he had great time. [scats] and man I used to jump off the stool, I said this guy’s great, I loved it. But anyway what happened was there was a bass player, his name was Bob Carter. Actually he had a long Hawaiian name, but he changed it to Carter because nobody could ever say his name,…
